text.tspan: Lambda failing: read the error, then match it to a cause
Task timed out after N seconds
Timeout too low or a call hangs: VPC Lambda without NAT/endpoint, slow DB
Runtime exited / signal: killed, Max Memory Used = Memory Size
Out of memory: raise memory (also gives more CPU)
Execution role missing a permission (or KMS key policy)
Bad package, wrong handler name, missing layer or dependency, wrong architecture
Code bug or missing env variable: roll back to the previous version/alias
ENI / subnet errors, can't reach RDS
Security group, subnet IPs exhausted, RDS SG not allowing the Lambda SG
